capabilities: Display a tick rail with one mark per heading at the note edge
Highlight the tick of the section currently being read
Expand the rail into a full heading outline on hover or tap
Jump to a heading by clicking or tapping its tick
Move the rail to the right edge and respect reduced-motion settings
disambiguation: Not a smooth-scrolling or scrolling-behavior tool; it adds an in-note heading rail for jumping between sections.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states the plugin makes no network requests and collects no data.
intentEvidence: Obsidian has an outline view for this, but it lives in the sidebar, and the sidebar is closed most of the time.
problem: Obsidian's outline view lives in the usually-closed sidebar, so navigating long notes means scrolling up to check section names and losing your place.
summary: Heading navigation rail that shows one tick per heading at the note edge, highlights the current section, and expands into a clickable outline on hover.
